description_en: Revokes a specified SCIM credential. This operation does not automatically create a new token, modify the AC synchronization switch, or disable SAML logon
description_zh: 撤销指定 SCIM 凭据。不会自动创建新 Token、修改 AC 同步开关或关闭 SAML 登录
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore delete-identity-provider-scim-credential --workspace-id ws-example --credential-id credential-example --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the target workspace. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the credential to delete. Use the ID returned in the credential list instead of the plaintext token
parameters.help_zh: 删除时必填非空，使用凭据列表返回的 ID，不是 Token 明文
parameters.name: credential_id

code.description_en: The result code. Handle failures based on the HTTP status code and message
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. This does not indicate the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: The message returned for the request. For asynchronous tasks, query the task result by calling the corresponding API operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues. Keep the ID if the request fails
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates that the request was successful. For asynchronous write operations, you must still query the task result
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
